description.value:
The changelings of Lorwyn are charming shapeshifters who can clumsily imitate the shapes of creatures and plants. Unlike most shapeshifters, though, their gift doesn't let them truly disguise themselves: the changes are only skin-deep.

Whatever their shape, they keep their telltale features—blue-green skin, tufts of tentacle-like fur, and bulging yellow eyes with slit pupils—so a bug-eyed tree, a teal elk, or a furry boulder is always easy to recognize. Many in Lorwyn find these clumsy imitations oddly endearing. Lorwyn changelings live in Velis Vel Grotto, a vast mystical cave, where many return once a year to reflect on their past deeds.

Changeling Traits

Creature Type: Fey

Size: Medium (about 4–7 feet tall) or Small (about 2–4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

Speed: 30 feet

Darkvision: 120 feet

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.species.Item.JQjlt9L8K6DMq6d9]{Shape Self}. As an action, you can reshape your body into a two-legged Humanoid shape or a four-legged Beast shape. While in Humanoid shape, you can wear clothing and armor made for a Humanoid of your size.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.species.Item.CKNNI93Atq9lXb8a]{Delightful Imitator}. You have proficiency in the Deception or Performance skill.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.species.Item.a0MOd0QYCG0IFbu0]{Unpredictable Movement}. Whenever you roll Initiative, you can immediately move up to half your Speed, unless you have Disadvantage on the Initiative roll.
